verdict.rationale: Running an AI agent from a mobile terminal is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions an AI agent, pull-request integration, or code-review suggestions. Pure-Python pip installs, built-in languages and the Shortcuts or relay automation are only developer building blocks a user could assemble themselves, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent analyze my pull requests and suggest code improvements from my phone
